deadline.value: For September 2027 start, applications open December 1 and close April 1.
deadline.quote: September (Fall semester) program start date Applications open December 1 Applications close April 1

fee_waiver.value: The CAD 135 fee cannot be waived.
fee_waiver.quote: A $135 CAD non-refundable application fee payment is required. This fee cannot be waived.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: Thesis programs: TOEFL iBT 100 with at least 25 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: In-person or special at-home edition – 100 with at least 25 on each individual skills areas

ielts_min.value: Thesis programs: IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: 7.5 with at least 7.0 on each test band

supervisor.value: A research professor must agree to take you (with financial support) before you apply.
supervisor.quote: It is necessary for applicants to the thesis-based programs to have a supervising research professor willing to take you on as a student before applying to the program.

funding.value: The department requires every PhD student to be funded; U of A guarantees at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4.
funding.quote: The department requires all PhD students to receive financial support and have an academic supervisor.

also.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

entry_route.value: Without an MSc you first enrol in the BME MSc and then transfer to the PhD; MSc holders take only two courses.
entry_route.quote: Students must first enroll in the biomedical MSc program and then transfer to the PhD program.

notes: Joint department of Engineering and Medicine & Dentistry.
